description: Span inputs and the exact ai_otel_span message (minus context.wrapperLibrary and the type key the RudderStack client adds) both SDKs must produce. Cases with aiContext/interaction run the span processor (created with linkTraceId when the case sets it) onStart under that AI context (and interaction) first; expectedInteractionTraceId is the interaction trace id afterwards (null: none); expectedExportedByDefault is whether the default AI-span filter exports the started span. Generated by ai-sdk-node test/tracing/conformance.test.ts. With captureContent, string values of content attributes and every attribute of content events are masked as spec/fixtures/redaction-v0.1.json specifies (a withheld value is removed); ai.request.headers.* attributes are never exported. A case with `spans` (instead of `span`) exports them in one batch through the exporter; `client.throw_on_span_id` makes the client's track() throw for that span's message; `expected` is then the list of messages the client received (the export result is FAILED).
